Add WDAY as a vertical system-of-record candidate for HR and finance agents; evidence should focus on AI actions, agent monetization, and whether AI improves workflow value rather than just product packaging.
Add ESTC as a retrieval/search/observability infrastructure candidate for production AI agents, especially where enterprise RAG, logs, and security telemetry are required.
IBM should be tracked as the public-market wrapper for Confluent's real-time governed data-streaming chokepoint after the acquisition, with emphasis on hybrid environments and AI-agent data flows.

node: Enterprise AI agents, data platforms, and workflow automation
summary: Expanded the public universe for the software-side AI deployment chokepoint beyond the obvious model/cloud leaders. The strongest second-order mappings are companies that already own enterprise workflow context, governed data streams, search/retrieval layers, DevSecOps context, or deterministic automation rails. These are plausible beneficiaries if enterprise AI spending shifts from raw model access toward trusted agents that can read enterprise context, respect permissions, execute workflows, and produce auditable outcomes.
